At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**The Senior Manager, Clinical Programming is responsible for the establishment, governance, and integrity of Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) standards, perform sponsor oversight of relevant programming activities on the Biometrics vendor, ensure the quality and consistency of data standards to support the portfolio towards the ultimate objective of data quality and consistency across programs and systems.

**Responsibilities

**

• Develops and implements company Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) standards that support the scientific need of a study/program while ensuring quality, consistency and compliance to CDISC standards and other industry standards that supports the exchange of data, reporting, and analysis.

• Ensures alignment of SDTM standards with data collection standards and relevant company tools/system requirements by reviewing study eCRFs, supporting creation of external data collection standards, and providing SDTM mapping guidance

• Serves as a subject matter expert on all aspects of standards development that includes industry standards (CDISC), regulations, and processes

• Ensures study or portfolio-level SDTM datasets are in compliance with CDISC and regulatory submission requirements, reviews study submission data packages to ensure quality and integrity

• Directly supports knowledge development of others as a subject matter expert on data standards, reporting and analysis standards, change control management and related tools/applications

• Creates quality control processes, metrics and other measures to ensure compliance with standards

• Ensures work carried out in accordance with applicable SOP’s and working practices, as well as global agency regulations/guidance’s

• Creates any needed documentation and training for standard processes, change control management and tools

• Responsible for defining standards specifications working closely with implementation support teams (database set-up, completion guidelines, CRF designers, procedures, algorithm specifications and reporting requirements)

• Facilitates a culture of continuous process improvement and a high level of customer service by maintaining and improving the standards processes associated with standards creation, maintenance, decision-making and implementation

• Working with Digital Solutions and IT, support the implementation of future strategies and technology-enabled processes and tools for clinical trials standards, change control management and the exchange of standards information to internal downstream consumers and externally consumers

• Serves as a liaison between Clinical Programming and External Data Management to ensure data standardization alignment and proactively resolve external data issues that impact SDTM deliverables.

**Requirements

**

• Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Life Sciences. Master’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Life Sciences preferred

• At least 6-8 years relevant experience in a pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO or Regulatory Agency

• Proficient in SAS programming, 6-8 years experience.

• Practical knowledge and experience using R to support clinical trial preferred

• Demonstrated knowledge of clinical research, metadata management, industry standards (CDISC), FDA & ICH, GCP, and related regulatory requirements

• Demonstrated experience managing multiple tasks, complex projects and working with cross functional teams delivering to project and portfolio timelines and metrics

• Strong verbal and written communication skills; independent and effective working in a multi-study, multi-disciplinary atmosphere in a matrix environment

• Experience in clinical data management and/or trial management experience with technical expertise in standards management and implementation is preferred.

For US based candidates, the proposed salary band for this position is as follows:

$131,040.00---$196,560.00

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When You Join Genmab, You’re Joining a Culture That Supports Your Physical, Financial, Social, And Emotional Wellness. Within The First Year, Regular Full-time U.S. Employees Are Eligible For

• 401(k) Plan: 100% match on the first 6% of contributions

• Health Benefits: Two medical plan options (including HDHP with HSA), dental, and vision insurance

• Voluntary Plans: Critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance

• Time Off: Paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and 12 weeks of discretionary paid parental leave

• Support Resources: Access to child and adult backup care, family support programs, financial wellness tools, and emotional well-being support

• Additional Perks: Commuter benefits, tuition reimbursement, and a Lifestyle Spending Account for wellness and personal expenses

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Please note that if you are applying for a position in the Netherlands, Genmab’s policy for all permanently budgeted hires in NL is initially to offer a fixed-term employment contract for a year, if the employee performs well and if the business conditions do not change, renewal for an indefinite term may be considered after the fixed-term employment contract.

jobs.description:
Vi søger 1 kok til vores restaurant i Hundested.

Har du passion for autentisk kinesisk madlavning, gode råvarer og kulinariske oplevelser? Har du samtidig erfaring med sushi, er det en ekstra fordel. Så er du måske vores nye kollega!

YoYo Restaurantionsselskab ApS er en kinesisk restaurant beliggende på Nørregade 29A, 3390 Hundested. Vi lægger vægt på traditionelle kinesiske retter, autentiske smagsoplevelser og god service i hyggelige omgivelser. Vores køkken kombinerer kinesiske madtraditioner med et udvalg af andre asiatiske retter, herunder sushi.

Vi søger en dygtig og engageret kok med erfaring inden for kinesisk gastronomi, som kan bidrage til den daglige drift og den fortsatte udvikling af vores køkken. Du bliver en del af et team, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og respekt for asiatiske madtraditioner er i centrum.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

• 
Tilberede autentiske kinesiske retter med fokus på kvalitet, smag og præsentation.

• 
Klargøre råvarer samt fremstille saucer, marinader og andre centrale elementer i det kinesiske køkken.

• 
Medvirke til udvikling og tilpasning af menuer og nye retter.

• 
Efter behov bidrage til tilberedning og anretning af sushi og andre asiatisk inspirerede retter.

• 
Sikre korrekt håndtering og opbevaring af råvarer samt overholdelse af gældende hygiejne- og fødevaresikkerhedsregler.

• 
Bidrage til en effektiv og velfungerende daglig drift i samarbejde med resten af køkkenteamet.

Vi forventer, at du

• 
Har praktisk erfaring med kinesisk gastronomi og gerne kendskab til forskellige regionale kinesiske køkkentraditioner.

• 
Har en god forståelse for råvarer, traditionelle tilberedningsteknikker og sammensætning af smage.

• 
Gerne har erfaring med tilberedning af sushi, herunder håndtering af råvarer, tilberedning af sushiris, rulleteknikker og anretning. Erfaring med sushi er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

• 
Kan arbejde selvstændigt, struktureret og effektivt – også i travle perioder.

• 
Har sans for detaljer, kvalitet og præsentation af maden.

• 
Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og har gode samarbejdsevner.

• 
Har lyst til at bidrage aktivt til restaurantens udvikling og fastholde en høj gastronomisk standard.

• 
Gerne taler kinesisk, da det kan være en fordel i den daglige kommunikation og i arbejdet med traditionelle kinesiske opskrifter. Det er dog ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder

• 
En spændende stilling i en veletableret kinesisk restaurant med stærk lokal forankring.

• 
Mulighed for faglig udvikling og indflydelse på køkkenets retter og menuer.

• 
Mulighed for at arbejde med både traditionelle kinesiske retter og andre asiatiske specialiteter, herunder sushi.

• 
Et uformelt og samarbejdsorienteret arbejdsmiljø med plads til engagement og faglig stolthed.

• 
En varieret arbejdsdag med engagerede kollegaer.

• 
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter kvalifikationer og nærmere aftale.

Om os

Hos YoYo Restaurantionsselskab ApS handler mad om mere end blot at stille sulten. Vi ønsker at skabe autentiske madoplevelser, hvor traditionelle tilberedningsmetoder, velafbalancerede smage og gode råvarer går hånd i hånd.

Fra duften af frisklavede wokretter til omhyggeligt tilberedt sushi stræber vi efter at tilbyde vores gæster en varieret og mindeværdig asiatisk madoplevelse i hjertet af Hundested.

Ansøgning

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig? Så hører vi gerne fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til restauranten, eller kontakt os for yderligere oplysninger om stillingen.

YoYo Restaurantionsselskab ApS
Nørregade 29A
3390 Hundested

We are looking to recruit 1 chef for our restaurant in Hundested.

Are you passionate about authentic Chinese cuisine, quality ingredients, and creating memorable dining experiences? Do you also have experience in sushi preparation? If so, that would be an additional advantage, and you might be the perfect addition to our team!

YoYo Restaurantionsselskab ApS is a Chinese restaurant located at Nørregade 29A, 3390 Hundested, Denmark. We take pride in serving traditional Chinese dishes, offering authentic flavors, and providing excellent service in a welcoming atmosphere. Our kitchen combines Chinese culinary traditions with a selection of other Asian dishes, including sushi.

We are currently seeking a skilled and dedicated chef with experience in Chinese cuisine to support our daily kitchen operations and contribute to the continued development of our culinary offerings. You will join a team that values quality, cooperation, and respect for Asian culinary traditions.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Prepare and cook authentic Chinese dishes, maintaining high standards of taste, quality, and presentation.

• 
Prepare ingredients, sauces, marinades, and other essential components of traditional Chinese cuisine.

• 
Participate in developing and refining menus and introducing new dishes.

• 
Assist with the preparation and presentation of sushi and other Asian-inspired dishes when needed.

• 
Ensure proper handling and storage of ingredients and compliance with applicable food hygiene and safety regulations.

• 
Work closely with other kitchen staff to maintain efficient and well-organized daily operations.

Requirements and Qualifications

• 
Practical experience in Chinese cuisine, preferably with knowledge of different regional Chinese culinary traditions.

• 
Good knowledge of ingredients, traditional cooking techniques, and flavor combinations.

• 
Previous experience in sushi preparation, including ingredient handling, sushi rice preparation, rolling techniques, and presentation, would be an advantage. Sushi experience is preferred but not required.

• 
Ability to work independently, efficiently, and systematically, including during busy service periods.

• 
Strong attention to detail, food quality, and presentation.

• 
Reliability, responsibility, and good teamwork skills.

• 
Motivation to contribute to the restaurant's continued development and maintain high culinary standards.

• 
Chinese language skills are considered an advantage, as they may support daily kitchen communication and the preparation of traditional Chinese recipes. However, they are not mandatory.

What We Offer

• 
An exciting position at an established Chinese restaurant with strong connections to the local community.

• 
Opportunities for professional development and involvement in menu planning.

• 
The opportunity to work with both traditional Chinese dishes and other Asian specialties, including sushi.

• 
A friendly, informal, and collaborative working environment that values dedication and professional pride.

• 
A varied working day alongside dedicated colleagues.

• 
Salary and employment conditions based on qualifications and mutual agreement.

About Us

At YoYo Restaurantionsselskab ApS, food is about more than simply satisfying hunger. We aim to create authentic dining experiences by combining traditional cooking techniques, balanced flavors, and quality ingredients.

From the aroma of freshly prepared wok dishes to carefully crafted sushi, we strive to offer our guests a diverse and memorable Asian dining experience in the heart of Hundested.

Application

Interested in joining our team? We would be pleased to hear from you.

Please send your application and CV to the restaurant or contact us for further information about the position.

Siteimprove helps organisations make their digital content accessible to everyone. Our accessibility products scan entire web estates and document libraries, find the barriers that stop people using them, and increasingly fix those barriers automatically. The work is measured in public: our customers are universities, health systems, government agencies and Fortune 500 companies who have legal deadlines to meet and auditors to satisfy.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead one of our two accessibility product teams. You will own the delivery, quality and technical direction of a cross-functional team of engineers working alongside a Product Manager and a Designer, and you will be accountable for what that team ships and for how the people in it grow.

This role sits at a genuine inflection point. We are moving from finding accessibility problems to explaining and fixing them, and we are rebuilding how we develop software around AI agents that write, test and review code under human direction. We need a leader who is credible in the code, fluent in modern AI-assisted development, and able to coach a team through that change without trading away quality or the well-being of the people doing the work.

What we will be doing

• 
Own delivery for your team. Turn a product roadmap into a sequenced, realistic plan, keep commitments honest, and be the person who says early and clearly when something will not land.

• 
Lead the people. Hold regular one-to-ones, give direct and useful feedback, run performance and growth conversations, and build a team where engineers at different levels can do their best work. Recruit, onboard and retain.

• 
Stay hands-on enough to be credible. Read and review code and designs, take part in architectural decisions, and pair with engineers when it helps. You are not expected to carry a full delivery load, but you are expected to understand the system well enough to challenge a design and to know when an estimate is wrong.

• 
Coach the team in AI-assisted development. Raise the whole team's effectiveness with AI tooling: how to decompose a problem so an agent can take it, how to write a prompt and a specification that produce reviewable work, and how to review agent-generated code properly rather than approving it on sight.

• 
Set the standards for how AI-generated work is accepted. Define with your engineers how such work is reviewed, tested, secured and documented before it merges, and hold the line that a human is always accountable for what ships.

• 
Partner with Product and Design as equals. Work with your Product Manager on outcomes, scope and sequencing, and make the technical trade-offs visible so the three of you decide together.

• 
Work across teams. Depend on and contribute to Platform, AI and other product teams. Much of what your team needs will be built elsewhere, and much of what it builds will be consumed elsewhere.

• 
Protect engineering health. Hold a deliberate balance between roadmap delivery, compliance obligations, customer-reported defects and technical debt, and make that balance explicit rather than letting it be decided by whatever is loudest.

• 
Own quality and operational responsibility. Testing, accessibility conformance of our own products, security and vulnerability remediation, incident response and the reliability of what your team runs in production.

• 
Adjust your working hours to overlap with the United States. This role reports to a manager on the US Pacific coast and partners with colleagues across the US. You will regularly take meetings in the late afternoon or early evening Central European Time, and we will protect the rest of your week in return.

• 
Travel may be required; a valid passport is required

• 
Perform other duties as assigned

What we will require of you

• 
Engineering management experience. Several years leading software engineering teams as their direct manager, including hiring, performance management and developing engineers at more than one level. You have owned delivery for a team over a sustained period, not just a project.

• 
A real software engineering background. You have built and shipped production software yourself and can still read a pull request, follow a design discussion and form your own view. We will talk about systems you have built.

• 
Depth in at least one of our core languages, and comfort across the rest. Our services are written mainly in C# and .NET, TypeScript and JavaScript, Go, Rust and Python. You do not need all of them; you do need to be genuinely strong in one and unafraid of the others.

• 
Modern cloud and delivery practice. AWS, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, continuous integration and deployment pipelines, observability and on-call practice.

• 
Practical use of AI in the software lifecycle. You have personally used AI coding assistants and agents on real work, you know where they help and where they mislead, and you have opinions about how their output should be reviewed. Experience helping other engineers adopt them is what sets this role apart.

• 
Strong partnership with Product. A track record of working with Product Managers and Designers as a peer, shaping scope rather than receiving it.

• 
Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical audience.

• 
Willingness to work a shifted day. Regular overlap with US Pacific time, and occasional travel.

What we will love about you

• 
Digital accessibility knowledge. Familiarity with WCAG, assistive technology, or the accessibility conformance and reporting that regulated customers require. If you do not have it, you must be willing to learn it properly — it is the product.

• 
Experience in a compliance or regulated environment, such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001 or a public-sector authorisation, and comfort working inside an audited change process.

• 
Open-source stewardship. We build and maintain an open-source accessibility rules engine, and experience running a public project and its community is valuable.

• 
Large-scale data or crawling systems, document processing, or machine learning applied to content analysis.

• 
Experience leading a distributed or multi-site team, including working effectively with contractors and vendor partners.

• 
Having introduced AI-assisted development to an organisation, including the governance, measurement and change management that goes with it.

• 
Danish language skills are a nice-to-have and are not required; our working language is English.

What you'll love about usWe’re building the next generation of AI-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross-functionally, and contributing to a product with real-world impact, we’d love to connect.

jobs.description:
The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) at Aarhus University, Denmark, invites applications for a two-year postdoctoral position in plant regulatory genomics and artificial intelligence, starting 1 April 2027.

You will design new sequence-to-expression deep learning models that predict gene expression from DNA sequence in plants, using new experimental datasets generated in the project. The position includes a 6- to 12-month research stay at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL), USA, combining plant genomics expertise at Aarhus with AI expertise at CSHL.

This is an opportunity to advance the state of the art in AI for plant biology while working across two leading research environments. For more information, feel free to reach out to Guillaume Ramstein (QGG) and Peter Koo (CSHL).

Expected start date and duration of employment

This is a 2-year position from April 1st 2027, or as soon as possible.

Job description

You will advance the field of artificial intelligence applied to regulatory genomics, as part of the GRASP project funded by the Independent Research Fund Denmark. In this project, you will leverage new training sets, build novel deep learning architectures and define dedicated learning objectives, to learn the effects of genetic variants on gene expression.

The position will focus on data science and genomics in a model plant species, Brachypodium distachyon. You will work at the cutting edge of AI in biology and propose new solutions to predict the effects of regulatory variants in plant genomes, which remains an open research problem in plant genomics. 

These activities will be carried out in close collaboration with the Koo lab, a leading group in AI and regulatory genomics at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL), USA. As part of this collaboration, the position will include a 6- to 12-month research stay in the Koo lab.

Your profile

Applicants should hold a PhD in computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field, or expect to complete it before the start date. They should have research experience in deep learning.

Applicants are expected to have published in international peer-reviewed journals, preferably on topics related to AI and genomics. Experience in developing new deep learning techniques (model architectures or learning objectives) is especially relevant to this position. 

Good communication skills in English are required, as well as the ability to work in an interdisciplinary team of AI experts, computational geneticists, and plant biologists.

Who we are

The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) is a major center for research and education in quantitative genetics and genomics at Aarhus University (http://www.qgg.au.dk/en). We conduct basic and applied research in animal, plant, and human genetics. Our focus areas include quantitative genetics, artificial intelligence applied to agriculture and medicine, population genetics, and integrative genomics. Research within QGG is characterized by a very close synergy between method development and application on practical problems across species, in collaboration with industry partners. QGG is an international research center with about 70 employees and visiting researchers from over 15 nations. QGG works in teams and strives for an excellent working environment, in which we value self-leadership, open communication, and commitment to diversity and inclusion.

What we offer

The succesful candidate will be offered:

• A 6- to 12-month research stay in the Koo lab at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL), USA, providing international experience and the opportunity to work across two leading labs in plant genomics and AI.
• Computational ressources, including the GenomeDK high-performance computing cluster, with growing capabilities such as high-memory nodes and state-of-the-art GPUs.
• An interdisciplinary interdisciplinary environment, in which the candidate will be able to exchange across research fields (machine learning, bioinformatics, biology, and quantitative genetics) and applications (plant biology, agriculture, and biomedicine).
• A research environment characterized by collaboration, professionalism, commitment to diversity and inclusion, and success in mentoring and supervision.
• A healthy work-life balance.
Place of work and area of employment

The primary place of work is C. F. Møllers Allé 3, 8000, Aarhus (Denmark), and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments.

The position will also include a 6- to 12-month research stay at 1 Bungtown Rd, Cold Spring Harbor, NY 11724, United States. The time and duration of the research stay may be negotiated with the supervisors Guillaume Ramstein and Peter Koo.

Contact information

For further information, please contact:

• Tenure-Track Assistant Professor Guillaume Ramstein, +45 42 52 12 66, ramstein@qgg.au.dk
• Associate Professor Peter Koo, +1 516 367 5520, koo@cshl.edu
Deadline

Applications must be received no later than November 20th, 2026.

Om Aarhus Universitet

Aarhus Universitet er et fagligt bredt og forskningsintensivt universitet med høj kvalitet i uddannelse og forskning, og et stærkt engagement i samfundsudviklingen nationalt og globalt. Universitetet tilbyder et inspirerende uddannelses- og forskningsmiljø for 37.500 studerende og 9.000 medarbejdere med en årlig omsætning på 8,9 mia. kr. Læs mere på www.au.dk

Are you an experienced Product Sustainability Assessment professional? Then this is an exciting opportunity to strengthen Coloplast's product sustainability evidence and help translate environmental impact into better product decisions across the organisation.

About the job

You will be responsible for conducting and continuously improving life cycle assessments and product environmental impact assessments, ensuring robust methodologies, transparent assumptions and decision-relevant outputs. Based in the HQ in Denmark you will work across R&D, Operations, Supply Chain, Product and Project Management, Procurement and other functions, you will provide credible evidence to support product development, portfolio decisions, priority Impact4 roadmap initiatives and externally relevant assessments.

You will maintain and contribute to Coloplast’s LCA methodologies, assessment tools, environmental datasets and emission factors. Also support the quality assurance of product-related Scope 3 emission accounting, product KPI progress and other product sustainability metrics. The position offers an opportunity to provide technical expertise and play a key role in advancing Coloplast’s 2030 product sustainability ambitions.

The Sustainability Team

You will join Coloplast’s Global Sustainability team, which sits in Global Quality, Regulatory Affairs and Sustainability under Global Operations. The team leads the development and implementation of the company’s sustainability strategy, including Environment, Health and Safety, and supports the business in delivering on its Impact4 strategic commitments.

We are a team that values curiosity, integrity, collaboration and transparency. We strive to create an environment where people can do their best work while enjoying what they do. With direct report to the Head of Sustainability Product Impact, you will work alongside dedicated sustainability professionals and collaborate extensively across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

•    Apply specialist knowledge in life cycle assessment, product environmental impact assessment, methodologies, datasets, emission factors and product sustainability evidence.

•    Conduct LCAs and product impact assessments across climate and other relevant impact categories, ensuring robust methodologies, transparent assumptions and decision-relevant outputs.

•    Maintain and continuously improve LCA methodologies, assessment tools, datasets, emission factors and technical guidance to ensure consistency, credibility and scalability.

•    Provide environmental impact evidence, methodological guidance and practical tools to support product development, portfolio decisions and sustainability integration across business processes.

•    Support the development and harmonisation of product impact assessment guidance for medical devices, translating evolving scientific, payer, customer and market expectations into practical recommendations.

•    Maintain and contribute to the calculation methodology and quality assurance of environmental impact data used for product-related Scope 3 accounting, product KPI progress and other relevant sustainability metrics.

•    Define data requirements, quality standards and validation approaches for product-related supplier environmental data.

•    Develop, validate and translate product impact evidence into clear recommendations for Product and Project Management, Marketing, Market Access, Operations and other business functions.

What you bring

Qualifications:

•    Master’s degree or equivalent in engineering, environmental science, chemistry, sustainability, materials science or another relevant technical field.

•    At least three years of relevant experience in life cycle assessment, environmental footprinting, product environmental impact assessment, sustainability analytics or a closely related technical field.

•    Hands-on experience with leading LCA platforms such as SimaPro, Sphera, OpenLCA, etc. and associated databases.

•    Strong knowledge of relevant standards and methodologies, including ISO 14040/44, ISO 14067, PEF and related environmental assessment frameworks.

•    Strong analytical capabilities and experience working with complex datasets, emission factors, modelling assumptions and decision-support tools.

•    Ability to translate complex environmental assessments into clear, actionable recommendations for product development, portfolio decisions and business stakeholders.

•    Experience from MedTech, healthcare, pharmaceuticals or another regulated industry is an advantage.

•    Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and developing sustainability evidence for customers, payers, healthcare professionals, public tenders or regulatory submissions is an advantage.

•    Professional proficiency in English.

Join a skilled and collaborative laboratory team

Are you passionate about clinical research and eager to make a significant impact in the world of drug development? NBCD is seeking a dedicated Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to join our dynamic team at the forefront of international drug development research. Join us in an environment fueled by dedication and inspired by our core values: "Team up, Take on, and Try out." Here, you'll have the chance to make a significant difference while expanding your skillset.

Who are we?

NBCD, a key part of the Sanos Group with around 245 employees, is a world-leading CRO specializing in osteoarthritis and musculoskeletal diseases. We provide top-tier scientific and clinical trial services to the biotech and pharmaceutical industries. At NBCD, innovation is at our core, enabling us to develop life-changing medications efficiently through pioneering study designs and flawless execution. We focus on a few therapeutic areas, letting science drive our business, particularly in connective tissue diseases like osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis. Our comprehensive support covers everything from study design to regulatory affairs, ensuring expert handling at every step. Renowned worldwide for our scientific and operational excellence, NBCD leads in international medication development.

Your key role and responsibilities

Your role will be highly varied and include the following responsibilities:

• You will conduct on-site monitoring of NBCD trials according to ICH-GCP, which involves regular visits to hospitals and clinics in Denmark and other countries to:

• Ensure patient rights and safety are protected, and that physicians conduct trials according to protocols, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and approved procedures.

• Verify that electronically reported data is accurate, complete, and matches source data in patient files.

• Educate site staff and provide guidance on study-related matters.

• Write visit reports and follow-up letters to investigators.

NBCD has pioneered Risk-Based Monitoring, and you will play a critical role in Centralized Monitoring, a major part of this process. This includes:

• Remotely reviewing clinical database entries at our Søborg office to ensure data quality by proactively identifying issues, analyzing trends, and querying investigators for appropriate actions.

• Documenting findings and actions in centralized monitoring reports.

• Ensuring the Centralized Monitoring approach effectively identifies issues remotely.

Additionally, you will have the opportunity to work closely with our Clinical Trial Managers (CTM), assist them and gain responsibility for various tasks related to study or vendor management. These tasks can be tailored to your skills and interests.

Desired skills and experience

We are looking for candidates with an educational degree in health sciences who have experience with good clinical practice and clinical trials, whether through university projects or previous positions. Excellent communication skills are essential, and since most of our communication is in English, fluency in business English, both oral and written, is required.

Additionally, as the role involves on-site monitoring at Danish investigational sites, we prefer candidates who speak Danish natively or fluently.

Personal profile

You excel at working independently and take full accountability for your responsibilities. With a keen eye for detail, you understand that study monitoring relies on the accurate and thorough review of patient files and supporting documents. You are dedicated to meeting deadlines and following through on commitments, working persistently and with self-motivation.

You are committed to fostering a positive work environment where colleagues can thrive. You approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset, maintaining a positive and optimistic outlook that encourages collaboration and respects individualism.

You are comfortable with broad responsibilities, as we value agility and efficiency, and believe in empowering our employees with the freedom to operate and innovate. Your enthusiasm for innovative research drives your desire to learn new approaches and expand your core skill set.

Additionally, you are willing and able to travel both within Denmark and internationally, as our CRAs also monitor sites in English-speaking countries such as the UK and USA.

Are we the right cultural fit for you?

Our commitment to you is encapsulated in our promise to every one of our employees saying ‘Trust in you - in your development and impact´.

This pledge extends uniformly across all entities within the Sanos Group organization, including NBCD, ensuring that you feel its effects from the very offset of your interaction.

If you are curious about whether you would thrive within the Sanos Group culture and the Sanos Way of Leading, reflect on whether you see yourself working within our principles:

• Take on - Responsibility is given, and we inspire you to take it.

• Try out - Explore diverse tasks and grow professionally.

• Team up - We don’t just work together; we thrive together.

Want to know more? Check out the Voice of NBCD people here.

Apply and make a real impact

jobs.occupation: Post Doc in plant-derived extracellular vesicles
jobs.description:
Are you interested in extracellular vesicles from plants and their potential accumulation of unwanted compounds and are you willing to challenge conventional thinking? Then the Department of FOOD Science invites you to apply for a 2-year Post Doc position, funded under the Villum Experiment program.

Expected start date and duration of employment
This is a 2–year position from 1 January 2027, or as soon possible thereafter. 

Job description
The position will focus on the isolation and characterization of extracellular vesicles from plants and understanding their cargo in relation to abiotic conditions.

The Post Doc is expected to independently take part in cultivation of plants, optimizing methods for extraction of extracellular vesicles and development of targeted methods for assessing specific compounds. 

The Post Doc will likewise also be responsible for setting up and running bioactivity assays using mammalian cell-lines.

Your profile
Applicants should hold a PhD in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, toxicology or similar.

The preferred candidate has documented hands-on experience with extracellular vesicle isolation and characterization. Likewise hands-on experience with culturing of mammalian cells and various molecular techniques like qPCR, miRNA mapping and LC-MS, is considered positive.

Strong collaborative skills, including experience working in interdisciplinary environments, are essential. We also value creative thinking, personal drive, and excellent communication skills.

Who we are
The Department of Food Science is part of the Faculty of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University and includes research within the areas Food Chemistry and Technology, Food Quality, Food Metabolomics and proteomics, Sensory Science, Biofunctional Food, Systems Biology, and Plant Production. 

The Department currently employs ca. 145 full-time staff, including 31 senior academic staff, ca. 60 PhD students and Postdocs, and ca. 45 technical and administrative staff. In addition, there are ca. 45 Bachelor and Master thesis students and ca. 10 visiting students and staff, who together contribute to an international research environment where English is the preferred language in the laboratory, at meetings and at seminars.

The Department works in teams and therefore self-leadership, clear and open communication, success in mentoring, supervising and teaching are important qualities needed to be successful in the Department. In addition, the Department has a strong culture that is based on openness, equality, consultation, inclusion and contributing to the Department strategy and working environment are viewed as important.
Aarhus University Food Science: Pioneering Research Partnerships

What we offer 
The candidate will join the multidisciplinary research environment at AU FOOD, with activities spanning the entire food value chain from field to fork. The department provides access to state-of-the-art facilities for plant cultivation under controlled conditions, advanced instrumentation for biomolecular characterization, and two fully equipped cell culture laboratories.

The candidate will join an international and multicultural workplace where English is the primary working language. The department also offers a variety of social activities that contribute to a welcoming and inclusive environment.

Place of work and area of employment 
The place of work is Agro Food Park 48, 8200 Aarhus N, and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments. 

Contact information
For further information, please contact: Associated Professor, Martin Krøyer Rasmussen, +452216 9390, martink.rasmussen@food.au.dk.

Deadline
Applications must be received no later than 29 October 2026. 

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.

Are you an experienced and motivated OT Security Architect and do you want to leave your mark on the global energy industry? If so, we want to hear from you! 
 
Your position
 
In your new position as OT Security Architect in the Renewables division, you will be a valuable member of the OT Security Team, whose mission is to ensure excellent OT security deliveries on large-scale EPC substation projects. You will have the chance to take the architectural lead and help shape a collaborative team culture built on expertise and knowledge-sharing. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be at one of our offices in either Esbjerg or Copenhagen. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel 10–30 days per year.

“Every day, we help enable the green energy transition by building secure, resilient OT solutions that ensure renewable energy assets operate safely and reliably.” - OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.
 
Your tasks & responsibilities 

In our Renewables division, we have major EPC projects in the pipeline for both short- and long-term operations. As an OT Security Architect, you will take the architectural lead and support all OT Security areas across the EPC substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Contributing to the implementation of industry-accepted good practice and required Cyber/OT Security architecture at solution level, typically based on standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and NIS
• Helping define products and standards relevant to OT Security and infrastructure
• Hands-on experience with cybersecurity audits and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, Critical Infrastructure regulations, and IEC 62443
• Reviewing requirements/ITT packages and providing input to tenders consisting of calculations, solutions, descriptions, clarifications, and reservations
• Taking on an advisory or active role in infrastructure, identity access management, or logging/event-based activities
• Being responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing FAT, SAT, and SIT activities to ensure successful system delivery and integration
• Implementing customer-specific Cyber/OT Security requirements in substation design for multiple systems and subsystems, such as SCADA, low-voltage, HVAC, Auxiliary Control and Monitoring System, etc.

Crucial to this position is your ability to take ownership of project deliverables and coordinate OT Security deadlines with internal and external stakeholders. You should thrive in a leading role where your skills, collaboration, and structured approach help ensure that requirements are met.
 
Your profile & qualifications

You are a team player who enjoys leading projects and working with stakeholders to align on timing, scope, and objectives. You know when technical expertise should be brought in to support delivery. To us, this means that you have a structured and solution-oriented approach, the ability to influence stakeholders, and the dedication to see tasks through to completion.

You will be part of a team of six colleagues that values quality, attention to detail, and a flexible working environment. We are sociable, helpful, and open to input, and we work in a dedicated, structured, and execution-focused way while respecting the agility that is a natural part of our core tasks. We want the same from you.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

• A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in OT Security from a similar position
• A Tech Lead mentality – we are not seeking an extreme subject matter expert, but a well-rounded colleague who can work through heavily structured large projects involving many stakeholders 
• The ability to know when additional technical specialists or resources are needed to complete a project
• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English
• Experience working in complex engineering projects, as well as project and stakeholder management, is an advantage

If you have any questions, you are more than welcome to contact OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.
